name: mathlib_benchmark
description: A benchmark based on the Lean mathlib library for evaluating automated theorem proving and proof generation in a formal proof assistant. It measures models' ability to generate correct formal proofs or proof steps that are accepted by the proof assistant.
evaluation_method: task_success_rate (proof accepted/verified by the proof assistant)
reputation: Widely used within the formal-methods/theorem-proving community as a standard benchmark for proof automation and Lean-related research.
